name: HuBei NengTer Technology CO.,Ltd
summary: HuBei NengTer Technology CO.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading business in China and internationally. The company operates a B2B e-commerce platform for the e-commerce trading of plastics. It also engages in the production and processing of pharmaceutical intermediates, such as montelukast sodium intermediates, rosuvastatin intermediates, and isophytol, as well as vitamin E and its intermediates; and industrial park operation and leasing. In addition, the company offers software and information technology; financial leasing and information consulting; asset management; and factoring services.
